journey.name: contact pay private link pending
journey.description: Verifies that a saved contact who can be paid privately is never paid through public payment details while the private connection is still being set up. Requires two disposable Bitkit identities with contact payment sharing and public payment sharing enabled, and a funded first device. The second device must not have the first identity saved. No payment is sent. Toasts do not reach the UI snapshot, so capture a screenshot right after each Pay.

actions.action: On the first device, open Contacts and add the second identity by its Pubky key
Save the contact and verify Contact Saved shows the second identity's name
Open the saved contact from Contacts and tap Pay (id "ContactPay")

Verify from a screenshot that a toast titled "Unable To Pay Contact" with "Bitkit is setting up a private connection with this contact. Try again shortly, or ask them to send you a payment request." appears
Verify the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") does not open
On the second device, open Contacts and add the first identity by its Pubky key, then keep Bitkit open
On the first device, tap Pay (id "ContactPay") again; if the same toast appears, retry after 5 seconds
Verify the Request or Pay sheet (id "RequestOrPaySheet") appears, or the send amount screen (id "SendAmount") opens; on the sheet, tap Pay and verify the send amount screen opens
Close the send amount screen without paying
